Tomorrow at 2024-03-06T20:00:00+02:00 @David Loeffler will speak in the Rutgers Lean seminar. (Same zoom link as others, or DM me for the link.)

Title: Formalising analytic continuation of L-functions

Abstract: I will report on a project to formalise a foundational result in analytic number theory: the analytic continuation and functional equation of the Riemann zeta function, which are now formalised as part of Lean's Mathlib library. Riemann's famous 1859 paper gave two very different proofs, and I'll explain why one of them seems to be a lot harder to formalise than the other. If there is time, I'll also describe some ongoing efforts to extend this formalisation project to the case of Dirichlet L-functions and L-functions of modular forms.

If David allows it, then yes.

So yes, it will be recorded.
